jobs.name: feed-a
jobs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the entire attached edit target faithfully in crisp pixel art. Asset: exact 3 columns by 4 rows atlas of TWELVE square scenes, total 3:4 aspect ratio, edge-to-edge cells without any gutters or borders. Preserve each cell's subjects, outfits, poses, composition and setting in exact original row-major order. STYLE: Genuine designed SNES/GBA pixel art, hand-placed square pixel clusters, each cell designed on an approximately 128x128 grid then clean integer nearest-neighbor enlargement. Consistent pixel scale throughout; stepped contours, simple expressive sprite faces, disciplined 24-color ramps, large flat color clusters with 2-3 discrete shade steps. Must look like actual retro game art, NOT a painting with pixel texture or a pixelated photograph. Absolutely no antialiasing, smooth gradients, blur, grain, subpixel strokes, painterly rendering. No text, lettering, logos, watermarks. Wholesome, modest attire.
